name: Oath of Vengeance
description: The Oath of Vengeance is a solemn commitment to punish those who have committed grievously evil acts. When evil armies slaughter helpless villagers, when a tyrant defies the will of the gods, when a thieves' guild grows too violent, when a dragon rampages though the countryside - at times like these, Paladins arise and swear the Oath of Vengeance to set right what has gone wrong.
